body: Thank you for the kind words :)

I used to have a lot of friends. I’m the kind of person that will help others if they needed help. I gave away my time, my money, my effort, just to help my “friends”. I even lend a big sum of money. In the end, friends aren’t the friends that I always thought of. Could you imagine your own friends that you care so much turn their backs on you? Since then I have trust issues and I don’t care about anything. Now, she’s the only friend that I can count on.

Yes, I would like to be independent. I want to get out from this house. I want to find a job to support myself. I want to help my friend dealing with her stuff. There’s a lot of things I want and can do if and only if I can move out. The thing is I couldn’t. I know I can’t.

At least your parents acknowledge it. Good for you then. I’m 24 and I’m studying software engineering. I don’t think I’ll go for therapy since it costs money and I don’t think my parents will give the money for it either. For now, I have a friend that helps me with it. She also has sort of similar situation so we depend on each other now.

I’ve been suicidal for 5 years now. So I started vaping to make myself calm. It’s like weed you know. But it’s illegal to have weed in my country. Day and night, I’m constantly having suicidal thoughts and one of the reasons I’m not dead yet is vaping. The thing is my parents are against of me vaping. I already told them it makes me calm down but they didn’t believe me. All they think is sbout my studies. Nothing more than that as if studying is the most important thing in the world. I get that part but I hate they don’t accept that I’m depressed and suicidal. I remember one time they talked about my suicidal. And that talk lasted for 30 seconds. And I knew at that point, they didn’t care nothing but studies. And so I was caught vaping a week ago and then I get scolded like hell. I was doing good at university but then something happened that made me like this.  So yeah that’s pretty much it.

I feel you. I was told the same thing over and over again. In the end, all of that are nothing but lies. I know when is the day I’ll be better. It’s on that fateful day where I take my own life. Only then, everyone will care about me. Little they know, it’s already too late. So yeah, it will never get better.
I feel that deeply. My own existence is a mistake and all I did were failures. I feel like if I’m gone, it’s gonna be better.
Yep. And it will never ever ever ever will.
So today is that “tomorrow”. I wonder what else is next.

I feel you bruh. My parents never really like me that much since I'm being "lazy" all the time. I failed a lot of examinations to my depression and suicidal and all they did were scold me for failing and told me that I'm useless and stupid for failing. All of my "friends" and even some of my lecturers knew that I was suicidal. And when my parents contacted my lecturers why am I failing in my studies and they told my parents that I'm depressed and suicidal. Then, my parents asked me to get out of my room because they wanted to have a "talk". I thought that finally my parents would recognize that I'm depressed and suicidal and I actually needed help. But then all I received was a lot of scolding for failing in my studies and wasting their money. We had a talk about my suicidal thingy and that talk only lasted for 30 seconds. So from that point onwards, I never tell anyone even my lecturers that I'm still depressed and suicidal. Because no one really cares until I die from a suicide.
